name: United States of America
tagline: Expensive, precise, and lethal once the airfields are humming.
strengths: Best air force in the game once Airfields are up
Tomahawk Launchers out-range almost every base defence
Drones bolt onto vehicles for free repair, scouting and extra guns
Strategy Center stances swing a fight without spending credits
weaknesses: Units cost more than anything they will trade with early on
Very soft for the first five minutes — a committed rush ends the game
Airfields are large, fragile, and worth raiding
Infantry hordes overwhelm small numbers of expensive units
opening: Dozer -> Supply Center, pull both Chinooks onto the nearest supply pile
Barracks -> two Rangers for scouting and garrison clearing
Supply Drop Zone as soon as credits allow — it pays passively all game
War Factory -> Humvees, then Crusaders
Strategy Center (unlocks stances and the Paladin), then Airfield
signatureTactics: Garrison a central building with Rangers and Missile Defenders early
Comanche pairs hunting supply lines and dozers, never trading with AA
Tomahawk line behind a Crusader screen to peel base defences apart
Colonel Burton to silently demolish a superweapon or power grid
quirks: Drones attach to vehicles: Battle Drone repairs, Scout Drone spots, Hellfire adds damage
Strategy Center stance: Bombardment (range), Hold the Line (armour), Search and Destroy (damage/vision)
Supply Drop Zone gives income with no chinook risk

name: USA Air Force General
tagline: Owns the sky, rents the ground.
strengths: King Raptor and Aurora Alpha hit harder and survive more than stock aircraft
Stealth Comanches arrive unseen over supply lines
Carpet bombing erases infantry hordes and clustered production
Aircraft rearm and recover faster than anyone can replace ground losses
weaknesses: No Crusader or Paladin line — his ground army is thin and improvised
A fast ground rush kills him before the second Airfield finishes
Massed anti-air (Quad Cannons, Gattlings, Avengers) shuts the whole army off
Base defence is an afterthought
opening: Dozer -> Supply Center, both Chinooks mining immediately
Barracks -> Rangers, then a Patriot Battery on the main approach
Airfield as the first real investment
Second Airfield before any ground tech
signatureTactics: Raptor pairs sniping dozers and supply trucks from minute four
Aurora Alpha runs on superweapons, Command Centers and War Factories
Chinook-lift a Humvee ball behind the enemy economy
Keep a Patriot screen at home so he never has to land to defend
quirks: Aircraft are the army — losing air superiority loses the game
Countermeasures upgrade makes aircraft shrug off missile defences

name: USA Laser General
tagline: Immaculate defence, wired to a fuse box.
strengths: Laser Turrets out-damage any other static defence for the price
Laser Crusaders cut through armour with no travel time to dodge
Point Defence Lasers shoot incoming rockets and missiles out of the air
Cold Fusion Reactors are cheaper and produce more power than standard
weaknesses: Everything is power-gated — dark reactors mean dark turrets
Artillery out-ranges his defensive line and he cannot answer in kind
Missile-only armies do badly, but shell and gun armies walk through
Thin early game like all USA sides
opening: Dozer -> Supply Center, Chinooks onto supply
Cold Fusion Reactor early — the whole army keys off power
Barracks -> Rangers, Laser Turret on the main approach
War Factory -> Laser Crusaders
Strategy Center, then Airfield
signatureTactics: Turtle a chokepoint with Laser Turrets and push out with Laser Crusaders
Use Point Defence Laser coverage to walk into missile-heavy armies
Avenger units to blank enemy missiles over the army ball
quirks: Power is the single point of failure — protect and over-build reactors
Point Defence Laser intercepts rockets and missiles but not shells or bullets

name: USA Superweapon General
tagline: Survive her opening and you still have to survive the sky falling.
strengths: Particle Cannons are cheaper and recharge faster, and she fields more of them
EMP Patriots freeze vehicles in place inside her defensive envelope
Advanced Control Rods push more power out of every reactor
Late game is effectively unwinnable if she is allowed to reach it
weaknesses: Slow, greedy opening — she is at her weakest for the first eight minutes
A spread-out enemy base blunts every Particle Cannon shot
Killing the Particle Cannon uplinks resets her entire plan
Raids on dozers delay superweapons disproportionately
opening: Dozer -> Supply Center, Chinooks mining
Barracks and a Patriot Battery, because she must survive to tech
Cold Fusion Reactor -> Strategy Center
Particle Cannon uplink the moment it is affordable
signatureTactics: Hold a tight defensive perimeter and win on superweapon uptime
EMP Patriot line to strand armour inside Particle Cannon range
Chain Particle Cannon shots onto production rather than armies
quirks: Her clock is the real opponent — every minute favours her
Superweapon timers are public information: count them

name: People's Republic of China
tagline: Bring more of everything and let the horde bonus do the maths.
strengths: Overlords are the toughest thing on the field and carry upgrades on their back
Horde bonus makes massed identical units hit far above their cost
Gattling Cannons answer air and infantry from the same building
Hackers print credits without ever leaving the base
weaknesses: Slow ground units get kited by anything faster
No stealth and poor stealth detection outside the Listening Outpost
Long-range artillery picks the horde apart before it arrives
Nuclear reactors detonate when destroyed, inside your own base
opening: Dozer -> Supply Center, both Supply Trucks mining
Barracks -> Red Guard pairs to hold ground and scout
War Factory -> Battlemasters, keep five together for the horde bonus
Nuclear Reactor -> Internet Center for hackers, or Propaganda Center for upgrades
Gattling Cannon on the approach before the first air scout arrives
signatureTactics: Five-Battlemaster horde with a Dragon Tank behind to clear garrisons
Overlord with a Gattling Cannon on top as a mobile no-fly zone
Nuke Cannon or Inferno Cannon line to crack a turtled base
Black Lotus to capture a building or drain an enemy supply centre
quirks: Horde bonus: five or more of the same unit near each other gain attack
Propaganda Towers and Overlord speakers passively heal nearby units
Nationalism and Patriotism stack the horde bonus higher

name: China Tank General
tagline: A wall of armour that arrives early and never stops.
strengths: Tanks are cheaper, faster and roll off the line already veteran
Emperor Overlord carries its own propaganda aura and shrugs off massed fire
Can contest the map earlier than any other Chinese side
Armour count snowballs if the first push is not punished
weaknesses: Almost nothing in his arsenal answers massed air
Rocket infantry in garrisons trade brutally well against him
Artillery kills the ball before it closes
Committed to the ground: no flexibility if you deny the ground
opening: Dozer -> Supply Center, trucks mining
War Factory immediately — his tanks are the opening
Battlemaster pressure on the enemy supply line before minute five
Gattling Cannon at home only after the first push
signatureTactics: Early Battlemaster raid on dozers and supply trucks
Emperor Overlord spearhead with Battlemasters filling the horde bonus
Overrun infantry with tank treads rather than shooting them
quirks: Veterancy on delivery means his first tanks beat your first tanks
Overlords can mount Gattling, Propaganda or Bunker upgrades

name: China Infantry General
tagline: Bodies, endlessly, all of them already veterans.
strengths: Infantry arrive as veterans and scale into enormous hordes
Minigunners and Tank Hunters cover infantry and armour from one Barracks
Attack Outposts push the horde forward with healing and detection
Cheapest map control in the game
weaknesses: Flame and toxin delete whole hordes in seconds
Artillery and carpet bombing are equally catastrophic
Very little answer to heavy armour in open ground
Garrisons become death traps once the building burns
opening: Dozer -> Supply Center, trucks mining
Barracks first, then a second Barracks — production width is the strategy
Red Guard and Tank Hunter mix, pushed out to claim ground early
Troop Crawler to move the horde and detect stealth
signatureTactics: Early veteran Red Guard flood onto the enemy's supply line
Garrison every building on the approach with Tank Hunters
Troop Crawler drops behind the enemy line and unloads a full horde
quirks: All infantry start veteran, which changes every early trade
Horde bonus applies to infantry, so bigger really is better

name: China Nuclear General
tagline: Everything he owns is also a bomb, including his power plants.
strengths: Tanks leave a radioactive detonation behind when they die
Tactical Nuke Cannon flattens clustered armies and static defences
Nuclear reactors produce more power, so he techs faster
Nuke MiGs turn a bombing run into an area denial weapon
weaknesses: His own reactors detonate inside his base when destroyed
Clumped defenders are exactly what his whole arsenal wants
Long-range engagements deny his death-explosion value
Early aggression arrives before the nuclear tech does
opening: Dozer -> Supply Center, trucks mining
Nuclear Reactor early — power is his economy advantage
War Factory -> Battlemasters with the nuclear upgrades
Nuke Cannon once the front stabilises
signatureTactics: Trade tanks aggressively — his die better than yours
Tactical Nuke Cannon onto any static defensive line
Nuke MiG runs to make ground permanently uncomfortable
quirks: Death explosions mean you lose units even when you win the fight
His reactors are a liability you can exploit with a single raid

name: Global Liberation Army
tagline: Cheap, fast, everywhere, and impossible to finish off.
strengths: Fastest, cheapest army on the field — trades on volume and tempo
Tunnel Networks teleport the army across the map and heal it
Destroyed buildings leave holes that rebuild for a fraction of the cost
Black Market and salvage give income and free veterancy
weaknesses: No aircraft at all — the sky belongs to the enemy by default
Light armour everywhere; anything heavy wins a straight fight
Static defence is weak outside Stinger Sites and tunnels
Falls off badly if the early tempo is neutralised
opening: Worker -> Supply Stash, extra Workers onto supply immediately
Barracks -> Rebels for scouting, RPG Troopers for the first raid
Arms Dealer -> Technicals, then Scorpions
Tunnel Network toward the middle of the map to project the army
Black Market for income and upgrades
signatureTactics: Rebel and RPG raid on the enemy dozer line before minute four
Tunnel Network forward so reinforcements arrive already at the front
Jarmen Kell snipes vehicle crews, then infantry walk into free tanks
Bomb Truck disguised in an enemy column, driven into a superweapon
quirks: Buildings leave rebuildable holes — killing GLA structures is never permanent
Salvage crates from destroyed vehicles upgrade units on the spot
GPS Scrambler and Sneak Attack put an army where it should not be

name: GLA Toxin General
tagline: Poisons the ground you were going to stand on.
strengths: Starts with Anthrax Beta and can upgrade to Gamma — toxins never wear off
Toxin Tractors and Toxin Rebels clear infantry and garrisons instantly
Toxin Scuds leave lingering clouds that deny ground for free
Anthrax Bomb is a cheap answer to any infantry-based army
weaknesses: Toxins do very little to vehicles and nothing at all to aircraft
A fully mechanised enemy ignores most of his damage output
Light armour, like all GLA sides
No aircraft
opening: Worker -> Supply Stash, extra Workers mining
Barracks -> Toxin Rebels for the early raid
Arms Dealer -> Toxin Tractors
Tunnel Network forward, Black Market for income
signatureTactics: Toxin Tractor pairs erasing garrisons and infantry screens
Poison the enemy supply pile so workers cannot mine it
Anthrax Bomb onto any massed infantry formation
quirks: Toxin damage lingers on the ground after the attack stops
Against vehicles his damage profile collapses — he must catch infantry

name: GLA Stealth General
tagline: The army was always there. You simply could not see it.
strengths: Nearly the entire army is stealthed by default
Camo Netting hides buildings, so his base is hard to even find
Hijackers steal vehicles outright, turning your army into his
Booby Traps and Demo Traps punish careless expansion
weaknesses: One detector unravels the entire strategy
Straight firepower is below average once he is visible
Light armour and no aircraft
Loses badly to area damage swept across suspected positions
opening: Worker -> Supply Stash, extra Workers mining
Barracks -> stealthed Rebels to scout and hold ground unseen
Camo Netting on the base as early as possible
Tunnel Network forward, Arms Dealer for Rocket Buggies
signatureTactics: Park stealthed units on the enemy's expansion path and wait
Hijack the first vehicles that walk past unescorted
GPS Scrambler and Sneak Attack to open a second front inside the base
quirks: Assume every empty-looking piece of ground is occupied
Stealth breaks when he fires — the window to punish is short

name: GLA Demolition General
tagline: Every single thing he owns is a delivery system for explosives.
strengths: Terrorists are the cheapest way in the game to delete a tank
Demo Traps turn any piece of ground into a minefield
Bomb Trucks can disguise themselves and drive into anything important
Units detonate on death, so killing them is still a cost
weaknesses: Almost everything he has must physically touch you to work
Long-range units and aircraft are close to immune
Very light armour — he dies on the approach if you see him coming
No aircraft
opening: Worker -> Supply Stash, extra Workers mining
Barracks -> Terrorists and Rebels for the first raid
Demo Traps on your own chokepoints and expansions
Arms Dealer -> Bomb Trucks, Tunnel Network forward
signatureTactics: Terrorist packs onto any tank ball that lost its infantry screen
Bomb Truck disguised as an enemy vehicle, aimed at a superweapon
Demo Trap every supply pile the enemy is about to expand onto
quirks: Death explosions mean melee range is never safe near him
Cheap suicide units mean his army value is always lower than it looks
